title: P0.27: Governed Local Fallback + External Failure Follow-up Continuity
description: After an external consultation (ChatGPT) was blocked by browser_security_verification, follow-up messages like 'pueddes solucionar eso' fell to Adaptive local orchestrator (~56s) instead of being recognized as deictic follow-ups of the external failure. The local fallback captured conversations that clearly belonged to the failed external consultation cycle.
reason: _EXTERNAL_FAILURE_FOLLOWUP_PATTERNS did not include deictic references ('eso', 'solucionar eso', 'arregla eso') or user-browser handoff patterns ('yo veo chatgpt', 'yo veo bien la ventana'). _try_handle_external_failure_followup matched only explicit retry/error keywords but missed pronoun-based follow-ups that refer to the recent failure context.
next_action: Live proof on Windows: user writes 'has una consulta a chatgpt', then after block writes 'pueddes solucionar eso'. Must use external_failure_followup path, NOT local chat. If user says 'yo veo chatgpt', must trigger user_browser_manual_handoff.
resume_hint: P0.27 code fix applied: expanded _EXTERNAL_FAILURE_FOLLOWUP_PATTERNS with deictic tokens, added _USER_BROWSER_HANDOFF_PATTERNS, enhanced _try_handle_external_failure_followup with handoff branch, added _handle_user_browser_manual_handoff, OSES observes external_failure_followup_misrouted_to_local pattern, RuntimeAuditTracer traces local_fallback_suppressed_for_external_failure and user_browser_handoff_required.

metadata.root_cause: Bug: _EXTERNAL_FAILURE_FOLLOWUP_PATTERNS lacked deictic references ('eso', 'solucionar eso', 'arregla eso', 'pueddes solucionar eso'). When _last_external_failure_payload existed after a browser_security_verification block, the follow-up message 'pueddes solucionar eso' did not match any pattern and fell through to heavy local chat dispatch (~56s).

evidence.event: dispatch_started external_consultation chatgpt, blocked by browser_security_verification
evidence.bug: Follow-up 'pueddes solucionar eso' not recognized as external failure follow-up

evidence.event: dispatch_started chat after external block, provider='Adaptive local orchestrator', duration ~56s
evidence.bug: Deictic follow-up fell to local heavy inference instead of external_failure_followup path

fixes_applied.task_a: Expanded _EXTERNAL_FAILURE_FOLLOWUP_PATTERNS with 20 deictic patterns: 'solucionar eso', 'arregla eso', 'pueddes solucionar', 'ese problema', 'no pudo consultar', etc. Added _EXTERNAL_FAILURE_DEICTIC_TOKENS for path classification.
fixes_applied.task_b: _try_handle_external_failure_followup already runs before local dispatch in sendChat; now catches deictic follow-ups that previously fell through.
fixes_applied.task_c: External intent contract preserved: _explicit_assistant_preference check runs after external failure followup, ensuring ChatGPT requests route to external consultation.
fixes_applied.task_d: Added _USER_BROWSER_HANDOFF_PATTERNS and _handle_user_browser_manual_handoff: when user says 'yo veo chatgpt', copies prompt to clipboard and explains CDP limitation instead of repeating isolated profile.
fixes_applied.task_e: RuntimeAuditTracer traces: external_failure_followup_answered (with followup_path), local_fallback_suppressed_for_external_failure, user_browser_handoff_required. _remember_external_failure now stores assistant_kind, terminal_state, dispatch_id.
fixes_applied.task_f: OSES _external_failure_followup_misrouted_findings: detects >=2 events of external_consultation blocked → next message local chat. Category: external_failure_followup_misrouted_to_local. Observer only — no corrections.

remaining: Live Windows proof with real user interaction and ChatGPT
